newsitem.title: USA: US corporate new issues weigh upon Treasuries.
newsitem.headline: US corporate new issues weigh upon Treasuries.

text.p: Corporate supply continued to steal the spotlight in Friday's market as another $750 million in new capital securities hit the Street, weighing heavily on U.S. Treasury prices, dealers said.

"It's been a pretty hectic day...with several deals in syndicate and basically everything performing well," one high-grade syndicate source said. "Those deals that were priced today were pretty much cleaned up."
Among Friday's issuers were Citicorp Capital II's $450 million in 8.015 percent 30-year capital securities which priced to yield 107 basis points over Treasuries.
